sources.name: RideTube for iDrive 8 (beta)
sources.description: RideTube, the unofficial YouTube client, ported to iDrive 8 (beta, not yet confirmed on an iDrive 8 car); video plays only while parked.

sources.name: alexp50 BMW Apps
sources.description: Fifteen full-screen apps, including Ambient Studio, DPF Monitor, Drive HUD, Telemetry Studio, Waze HUD and xDrive Studio.

sources.name: JustAnotherPU MGU Apps
sources.description: Head-unit tools: iDrive Monitor (system monitor), wireproxy (for Tailscale) and Node.js 22.

sources.name: Waze HUD
sources.description: Waze turn-by-turn arrows from CarPlay on the HUD and instrument cluster; it uses cluster-render from the built-in idrive-apps source.

sources.name: bimmer-lab Apps
sources.description: Cluster Themes (redraws the instrument cluster) and HUD Widgets (custom HUD readouts); install cluster-render from the built-in idrive-apps source first.

sources.name: pinguinooo iDrive 7 Apps
sources.description: Shift Lights, Engine Vitals and an M Track cluster layout.

sources.name: hexlay Custom Apps
sources.description: A Spotify Connect controller and library browser, and M-Copilot, an AI assistant that reads vehicle data; the renderer comes from the built-in idrive7-apps source.

sources.name: Cluster Info, Layouts & Centre (eroobeeroo)
sources.description: Three apps that put live data and custom layouts on the instrument cluster and HUD; the head unit builds them from source.

also.why: the shared parts these apps build on

sources.name: iDrive 7 Cluster Apps (leonit-k)
sources.description: The same three cluster apps (Cluster Info, Cluster Layouts, Cluster Centre) as eroobeeroo's repo above; you only need one of the two.

also.why: the shared parts these apps build on
the HUD / map-layout additions to Waze on cluster

not_sources.name: BMW Ambient RGB Controller
not_sources.description: Gives a G20's factory ambient lighting any colour: hue ring, brightness, upper and lower zones, animated modes.
not_sources.why: built with the MGU App Kit and not published as a Store source; build and install it yourself from the repo.

not_sources.name: MGU App Store (JustAnotherPU fork)
not_sources.description: A fork of the MGU App Store itself.
not_sources.why: it is the Store, not a list of apps; the Bimmhacks MGU Tool installs the Store for you (App Store tab).

not_sources.name: NBT Evo ID6 apps (pre-release)
not_sources.description: BoostDeck, ShiftDeck and MHD Maps menus built for NBT Evo head units over ENET.
not_sources.why: made for the older NBT Evo (iDrive 6) unit, not the MGU; it does not run on iDrive 7 or 8.
